**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** yes

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
preload must be one of "eager", "idle", "visible", "intent", "interaction"
```

## How to fix

Set preload to one of "eager", "idle", "visible", "intent", "interaction" (string literal).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <a href="/x" preload="soon" />;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <a href="/x" preload="idle" />;
```

## Quick fix

The [language service](../guides/tooling/language-service.md) (editor) and the MCP `check_code` tool offer this code action:

- Change preload to "`{nearest}`"

## When it is reported

typescript-plugin drops RV1102 when TS already reports an error inside its range (index.ts:163).
